name: One clear step
approvalBasis: Owner delegated creative implementation and approved the Guided Day Canvas plan; selected for its single-action hierarchy, graphic trail, low data density, and compatibility with the established top navigation.
promptSummary: Top navigation, one clear primary action, a large geometric current-and-next learning arc, exactly three Today rows, an evidence band, and a customizable supporting area.
literalizationBoundary: All sample titles, counts, dates, and activities in the raster are illustrative. Production uses only current course, progress, review, mastery, and preference data.
